articles.title: Hackers Used Meta’s AI Support Bot to Seize Instagram Accounts
articles.summary: Microsoft drops a record-breaking 200 patches this Patch Tuesday, with 36 rated critical. When Redmond's own patch count looks like a CVE fever dream, you know it's been a rough month for secure coding.

articles.title: Victory! 702 has Expired!
articles.summary: CISA contractor casually dumps AWS GovCloud keys and agency secrets on public GitHub because apparently operational security is just a suggestion. Congress is demanding answers, and we're demanding better infosec training.

articles.title: Yes to California's Bill to Ban Surveillance Pricing
articles.summary: Section 702's warrantless surveillance authority finally expires after years of dragnet spying on Americans. Victory tastes sweet when the surveillance state has to actually ask permission for once.

articles.title: Claude Fable 5 Doesn't Change the Mythos Security Story
articles.summary: ShinyHunters weaponizes Oracle ERP zero-day to absolutely demolish higher education networks. Universities getting schooled in why patch management isn't optional homework.

articles.title: The Right’s “Election Fraud” Cry for Midterms Previewed in Primaries
articles.summary: Senator calls out DHS for ICE recruitment materials that white nationalists are celebrating. Apparently violent extremists infiltrating law enforcement is a feature, not a bug.

articles.title: A Point-by-Point Breakdown of Trump’s Failed Iran War Objectives
articles.summary: Hakeem Jeffries grows a backbone and rallies Democrats against extending domestic spy laws. Shocking development: politicians occasionally remember civil liberties exist.

articles.title: Google Sues Chinese Smishing Network Accused of Using Gemini AI in Phishing
articles.summary: Over 400 Arch Linux AUR packages hijacked to deploy credential stealers and eBPF rootkits. Supply chain attacks hitting the distro that arch users definitely saw coming but installed anyway.

articles.title: Agentjacking Attack Tricks AI Coding Agents Into Running Malicious Code
articles.summary: China-linked Velvet Ant backdoored Linux PAM and OpenSSH for nearly a decade, owning the login system itself. When you can't beat authentication, become authentication.

articles.title: ShinyHunters Exploits Oracle PeopleSoft Zero-Day (CVE-2026-35273) to Breach Universities
articles.summary: ShinyHunters exploited Oracle PeopleSoft zero-day CVE-2026-35273 to breach 100+ organizations, with universities taking the hardest hits. Oracle's enterprise software proving that critical infrastructure and security don't mix.

articles.title: Netherlands Seizes 800 Servers, Arrests 2 for Aiding Cyberattacks
articles.summary: Hackers trick Meta's AI support bot into resetting Instagram accounts, briefly defacing Obama White House and Space Force profiles with pro-Iranian messages. Even AI customer service can't escape social engineering.
